   492	CAPSTONE_EXPORT
   493	cs_err CAPSTONE_API cs_open(cs_arch arch, cs_mode mode, csh *handle)
   494	{
   495	        cs_err err;
   496	        struct cs_struct *ud;
   497	        if (!cs_mem_malloc || !cs_mem_calloc || !cs_mem_realloc || !cs_mem_free || !cs_vsnprintf)
   498	                // Error: before cs_open(), dynamic memory management must be initialized
   499	                // with cs_option(CS_OPT_MEM)
   500	                return CS_ERR_MEMSETUP;
   501	
   502	        if (arch < CS_ARCH_MAX && cs_arch_init[arch]) {
   503	                // verify if requested mode is valid
   504	                if (mode & cs_arch_disallowed_mode_mask[arch]) {
   505	                        *handle = 0;
   506	                        return CS_ERR_MODE;
   507	                }
   508	
   509	                ud = cs_mem_calloc(1, sizeof(*ud));
   510	                if (!ud) {
   511	                        // memory insufficient
   512	                        return CS_ERR_MEM;
   513	                }
   514	
   515	                ud->errnum = CS_ERR_OK;
   516	                ud->arch = arch;
   517	                ud->mode = mode;
   518	                // by default, do not break instruction into details
   519	                ud->detail = CS_OPT_OFF;
   520	
   521	                // default skipdata setup
   522	                ud->skipdata_setup.mnemonic = SKIPDATA_MNEM;
   523	
   524	                err = cs_arch_init[ud->arch](ud);
   525	                if (err) {
   526	                        cs_mem_free(ud);
   527	                        *handle = 0;
   528	                        return err;
   529	                }
   530	
   531	                *handle = (uintptr_t)ud;
   532	
   533	                return CS_ERR_OK;
   534	        } else {
   535	                *handle = 0;
   536	                return CS_ERR_ARCH;
   537	        }
   538	}

   540	CAPSTONE_EXPORT
   541	cs_err CAPSTONE_API cs_close(csh *handle)
   542	{
   543	        struct cs_struct *ud;
   544	        struct insn_mnem *next, *tmp;
   545	
   546	        if (*handle == 0)
   547	                // invalid handle
   548	                return CS_ERR_CSH;
   549	
   550	        ud = (struct cs_struct *)(*handle);
   551	
   552	        if (ud->printer_info)
   553	                cs_mem_free(ud->printer_info);
   554	
   555	        // free the linked list of customized mnemonic
   556	        tmp = ud->mnem_list;
   557	        while(tmp) {
   558	                next = tmp->next;
   559	                cs_mem_free(tmp);
   560	                tmp = next;
   561	        }
   562	
   563	        cs_mem_free(ud->insn_cache);
   564	
   565	        memset(ud, 0, sizeof(*ud));
   566	        cs_mem_free(ud);
   567	
   568	        // invalidate this handle by ZERO out its value.
   569	        // this is to make sure it is unusable after cs_close()
   570	        *handle = 0;
   571	
   572	        return CS_ERR_OK;
   573	}

   575	// fill insn with mnemonic & operands info
   576	static void fill_insn(struct cs_struct *handle, cs_insn *insn, char *buffer, MCInst *mci,
   577	                PostPrinter_t postprinter, const uint8_t *code)
   578	{
   579	#ifndef CAPSTONE_DIET
   580	        char *sp, *mnem;
   581	#endif
   582	        uint16_t copy_size = MIN(sizeof(insn->bytes), insn->size);
   583	
   584	        // fill the instruction bytes.
   585	        // we might skip some redundant bytes in front in the case of X86
   586	        memcpy(insn->bytes, code + insn->size - copy_size, copy_size);
   587	        insn->size = copy_size;
   588	
   589	        // alias instruction might have ID saved in OpcodePub
   590	        if (MCInst_getOpcodePub(mci))
   591	                insn->id = MCInst_getOpcodePub(mci);
   592	
   593	        // post printer handles some corner cases (hacky)
   594	        if (postprinter)
   595	                postprinter((csh)handle, insn, buffer, mci);
   596	
   597	#ifndef CAPSTONE_DIET
   598	        // fill in mnemonic & operands
   599	        // find first space or tab
